entries.title: Acts 14:1
segments: In preaching, the manner, as well as the matter, is important; and it should be the earnest desire, the fervent prayer, and the diligent effort of every minister of the gospel, so to speak that multitudes of all classes shall, through the grace of God, be led to believe.

entries.title: Acts 14:3
segments: Gave testimony; proved the truth of what they taught, by enabling them in his name to work miracles.

entries.title: Acts 14:4
segments: When great numbers embrace the gospel, those who continue to reject it are often filled with wrath against those who preach it. The community is divided. A part join the friends, and a part the enemies of Christ, and great commotions follow. These results wicked men attribute to the gospel; but they spring from opposition to it and the opposers, not the faithful preachers of the gospel, are responsible for the evils thus occasioned.

entries.title: Acts 14:6
segments: Lystra and Derbe; cities of Lycaonia, a province of Asia Minor.

entries.title: Acts 14:9
segments: Faith to be healed; confidence in the power of Christ, by means of Paul, to heal him.

entries.title: Acts 14:11
segments: Speech of Lycaonia; the language of that province.

entries.title: Acts 14:12
segments: Jupiter; considered by the Greeks and Romans as the greatest of their gods. Mercurius; regarded as the god of eloquence.

entries.title: Acts 14:13
segments: Before their city; in front of their city was a temple dedicated to Jupiter. Garlands; wreaths of flowers, with which they decorated the victims to be offered in sacrifice.

entries.title: Acts 14:14
segments: Rent their clothes; in token of their abhorrence of such sacrifices.

entries.title: Acts 14:15
segments: Men of like passions; frail, sinful, dying men. These vanities; the worship of false and imaginary gods. Faithful ministers of the gospel will be careful to let none think of them as any thing more than men, of like infirmities with other men; and if they are instrumental of good, they will inculcate upon all that the glory belongs wholly to God.

entries.title: Acts 14:16
segments: All nations; the gentile world. Their own ways; ways of idolatry and wickedness, without a written revelation.

entries.title: Acts 14:17
segments: Witness; evidences of his existence, power, and goodness.

entries.title: Acts 14:19
segments: Persuaded the people; persuaded them that Paul and Barnabas were bad men, and deceivers.

entries.title: Acts 14:22
segments: Confirming the souls; instructing and establishing them in the faith and practice of the gospel.

entries.title: Acts 14:23
segments: Ordained them elders; set apart persons to take the care, oversight, and instruction of the churches. Churches need officers to take the oversight of them, to instruct them, and labor for their spiritual good; and it is proper that they should be set apart to this work, that the influences of the Holy Spirit should be sought for them, and they be particularly commended to his gracious guidance and care.

entries.title: Acts 14:24
segments: Pamphylia; on their way back towards Antioch in Syria, from which they went. Chap

entries.title: Acts 14:25
segments: Attalia; a seaport in Pamphylia from which they could sail to Antioch.

entries.title: Acts 14:26
segments: The work which they fulfilled; the missionary work to which they had been appointed, chap

entries.title: Acts 14:27
segments: The church; the disciples at Antioch. Opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles; prepared the way to preach to them the gospel, and led them to embrace it. Correct accounts of the manner in which God has delivered his people from trials, and crowned their labors with his blessing, are very useful. They lead Christians to put greater confidence in him, to pray more earnestly for spiritual blessings, and with increased fidelity use the means which are needful to obtain them.
